job.name: ig41_host
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic still, filmed on a phone in a cosy evening interior, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, мужчина ~32 в кресле в вечерней гостиной, смотрит в камеру, губы приоткрыты, без надписей и логотипов
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: ведущий ~32, светлые короткие волосы, рыжеватая борода, оливковый пиджак, вечерняя гостиная
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame like a selfie-style talking video. A calm, self-assured Russian man about 32 with short light-brown hair, a neat trimmed reddish-brown beard, grey-green eyes, wearing an olive-green wool overshirt over a cream crew-neck sweater and a steel wristwatch. He sits relaxed in a dark brown leather armchair in a cosy modern living room at evening, one hand slightly raised in a calm explaining gesture, looking straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm slightly ironic expression, NO big smile. Medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge. Background: warm dim lamps, wooden shelves with books and a plant, softly blurred, warm amber light. Real camera frame, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
